outcome: Mean age of women undergoing OVD
cohort: The study observed 7,368,814 total births in Japan from 2014 to 2021 to analyze trends in operative vaginal deliveries.
finding: The study revealed an increase in the use of operative vaginal deliveries in Japan from 2014 to 2021, with large regional differences in the choice between vacuum and forceps deliveries.
mod_finding: Operative vaginal deliveries, encompassing both vacuum and forceps methods, showed an increasing trend in Japan from 2014 to 2021, with substantial regional disparities in the proportion of forceps deliveries among OVDs.
